source.name: LMArena
source.description: Official LMArena leaderboard dataset (latest snapshot, overall category per arena).
notes: Score = arena rating (Elo-style, higher is better); 95% bounds, rank and vote count in extra.
Only each arena's 'overall' category is included; developers are LMArena's organization field.
